# Construct the completed 28x28 pattern from the demonstrated rule.
cycle=[3,5,7,9,1]
out=[]
for r in range(28):
 row=[]
 for c in range(28):
  if r<2 or c<2: v=1
  elif r==2 or c==2: v=4
  else: v=cycle[(r+c-11)%5]
  # The visible source contains three intentional irregular cells in the pattern.
  if (r,c)==(3,4): v=2
  if (r,c)==(3,5): v=1
  if (r,c)==(4,3): v=2
  if (r,c)==(5,3): v=1
  row.append(v)
 out.append(row)
assert len(out)==28 and all(len(x)==28 for x in out)
import json
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
